vashil:portrait.prompt: Repaint this exact image as one finished, hand-painted fantasy game key-art illustration: painterly brushwork with soft and lost edges over the figure and the landscape alike, painted form and light, a rich value structure. Keep the composition, the camera, the framing, the background layout and the character's pose, silhouette, proportions, costume parts and colours exactly as in the reference. Do not add or remove props, limbs or figures; do not move, turn or resize the character. Add no colour, ornament, band or part that is not in the reference. Paint only what is visible in the reference: anything described below that is out of frame stays out of frame. Add no object, light source, sun disc, lens or prop that the reference does not show. Keep the reference's overall brightness and the background's value; do not brighten the image. A square head-and-shoulders portrait card. The character: a tall, straight bell-ringer: a round, smooth chalk cowl (a round dome, never pointed) with an arched clear glass visor pane over a carved pale chalk face-plate, a floating chalk ring of small clear glass bells with small blue clappers above the head, a chalk-pale robe with stone shoulder plates; the striking rod only where the reference shows it. No teeth, no grille and no mouth guard on the face. The face-plate behind the glass is carved and alive, never a blank white oval, a doll or a mannequin: keep its carved brow, nose and eyes exactly as rendered, with no marks, lines, cracks or streaks under the eyes. The nose is a smooth carved ridge with no nostril holes; no sunken cheeks, no deep round eye sockets, no cracked or aged surface: never a skull. Light: a low warm golden sun from the right, a warm rim light along the character's right edges, cooler shadow on the far side. Eyes: alive, with upper lids and dark pupils, looking out; never glowing, never solid colour, never empty or hollow, no bright or saturated ring round the iris; the irises exactly as muted and dark as in the reference, never more saturated or brighter. Hands: gloved hands with separate fingers, knuckles and a thumb exactly as in the reference, each finger where it is rendered; never a mitten, a block or fused fingers. Painted form, not a 3D render; no outline halo. No text, no letters, no logo, no signature, no border, no frame. Sensitivity: no blank, smooth, cracked or skull-like masks, no hockey masks, no mannequin faces, no empty or glowing eye holes, no glowing eyes; no animal ears, no full-head cowls, no capes, no skull plates, no horns; no tall, pointed or conical hoods (any hood is soft, low and rounded); no faceless crowds, no armies or rows of small soldiers, no little figures with faces on the roads; nothing that resembles a character from another game, film or comic.
